title: Colliquament
summary: COLLIQUAMENT, noun 1. The substance formed by melting; that which is melted. 2. Technically, the fetal part of an egg; the transparent fluid in an egg, containing the first rudiments of the chick. 3.

inlines.v: COLLIQUAMENT, noun 1. The substance formed by melting; that which is melted. 2. Technically, the fetal part of an egg; the transparent fluid in an egg, containing the first rudiments of the chick. 3. The first rudiments of an embryo in generation.
